servers.description: Explore your local files with fast glob matching and text search. Find files across directories and pinpoint patterns in code, logs, or docs. Focus searches on any folder to keep results relevant.

Text to speech for your AI.

Your AI can send text into the Document Player to read it aloud. You will see a reader window with the text and you can control playback sentence by sentence.

Find an example here:
https://documentplayer.com/connect-ai/
